name: sandpane
description: Sandpane Core attachment for VS Code: projects, Docker Sandboxes (sbx), coding-agent chats and Git-safe task review from a Copilot-style sidebar. Scaffold stage (P3) — see README.md for what is functional and what is an honest seam.

configuration.title: Sandpane
configuration.description: Client-side UI defaults. Sandpane Core owns all authoritative project/task/sandbox state (specs/02 §1); these values are never a second source of truth.

sandpane.sandboxDirectory.description: UI default shown in the sandbox wizard. Not sent to Core: protocol v1 has no settings RPC, and SBX directory policy stays server-side.

sandpane.defaultCPUs.description: UI default CPU allocation shown in the sandbox wizard. Not sent to Core (protocol v1 SandboxCreateSpec has no resource fields).

sandpane.defaultMemory.description: UI default memory allocation shown in the sandbox wizard. Not sent to Core (protocol v1 SandboxCreateSpec has no resource fields).

sandpane.defaultDiskSize.description: UI default disk allocation shown in the sandbox wizard. Not sent to Core (protocol v1 SandboxCreateSpec has no resource fields).

sandpane.maxParallelTasks.description: Client-side display ceiling for the task list. The Core scheduler enforces the real global/per-project limits (specs/02 §4).

sandpane.autoRefreshSandboxes.description: Poll sandbox.list on a timer. Off by default: each refresh makes Core probe the SBX CLI.

sandpane.attachDiagnostics.description: Explicit consent to attach the active file's diagnostics to a task (specs/03 §4). Off means diagnostics are never sent.

sandpane.serviceMode.description: What to do when Core is unreachable. 'auto' is intentionally not offered: the service ownership/auto-start policy (ADR 1, specs/02 §10) is undecided, so the extension never launches a binary.

sandpane.coreSocketPath.description: Override the Core Unix socket path. Empty uses SANDPANE_SOCKET, then the per-user default data directory (mirrors sandpane_service::default_socket_path).

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
